messages.subject: Re: [D-RUG]: No working group 11/28
parts:
Hi All,

For those of you interested in coming to the Google Earth Engine (GEE) workshop this Thursday 5th Dec, please sign up to GEE beforehand at this link here. Scroll to the bottom of the page and click Sign Up Now. I'm pretty sure it takes a couple of days to approve you as a user, so make sure to do this at the beginning of next week!

For those of you who don't sign up in time (i.e. if you're reading this email on Thursday), please still come along! You might not be able to use GEE on your own computer, but I'll be giving a quick intro to GEE first, and I'll have my code up on the big screen. 

Looking forward to seeing you all!

Cheers,
Amy
